```{r}
library(DBI)
library(odbc)

conn <- dbConnect(
  odbc::odbc(),
  "OAO Cloud DB Production"
)

objects <- c(
  "MV_DM_PATIENT_ACCESS",
  "ONCOLOGY_DEPARTMENT_GROUPINGS_TABLEAU",
  "ONCOLOGY_PRC_GROUPINGS_TABLEAU",
  "ONCOLOGY_DISEASE_GROUPINGS_TABLEAU",
  "VIZIENT_CANCER_GROUPER",
  "MV_PATIENT_SELECT_DEMOGRAPHICS",
  "ONCOLOGY_ETHNIC_BACKGROUND_PULL",
  "ONCOLOGY_LOS_EXCLUSIONS_TABLEAU"
)

for (obj in objects) {

  cat("\n-----------------------------\n")
  cat("TESTING:", obj, "\n")

  tryCatch({

    dbGetQuery(
      conn,
      paste0(
        "SELECT * FROM ",
        obj,
        " WHERE ROWNUM = 1"
      )
    )

    cat("SUCCESS:", obj, "\n")

  }, error = function(e) {

    cat("FAILED:", obj, "\n")
    cat(conditionMessage(e), "\n")

  })
}

dbDisconnect(conn)
```
